description: App-only adapter for the calendar in the selected salonId. action=replace prepares full replacement of rules for input.staffId; action=absence prepares an absence from startsAt to endsAt and the specific cancellations in cancelAppointmentIds. Saves a plan and effects without changing the calendar or cancelling appointments. In conversation, use beautyos_staff_schedule_replace_prepare or beautyos_staff_absence_create_prepare. Apply separately with beautyos_apply_change after explicit confirmation.
name: beautyos_prepare_schedule_change
title: UI: schedule change preview
